aliases: Green Beast Lord Green Beast Ah Le

summary.text: Green Beast is a youngster in Tu clan village during Meng Qiu Zhen's exploration of Paradise Earth's dream realm.

claims.text: At Tu clan village’s evening market, pedestrians make way for a group whose leader is a bald youngster. People call him Lord Green Beast. He is nicknamed Green Beast. He approaches Fang Tu, then argues with Huang Xiao Mi and fights him. After several rounds he suppresses Huang Xiao Mi. When Huang Xiao Mi’s identity as a mushroomman is exposed, Green Beast calls for others to attack together, captures him, and takes credit for the arrest.
The bald youngster has thick brows and large eyes, and has not even a single hair on his head. Instead, there is a tattoo of a green beast on his head.
He leads Huang Xiao Mi to Tu clan village’s prison, receives praise from the elders, and invites Fang Tu home for dinner. Only he and his mother live there.
Later that night Meng Qiu Zhen inhabits the bald youngster’s mother. He finds that this mother is a mushroomman, Huang Wan, and thinks she adopted a human child to conceal her identity.

Tu clan village’s champion in the war with the mushroomman tribe is the bald youngster, Huang Wan’s adopted son. Through contest with Huang Xiao Mi, both reach rank four at the same time. Green Beast is not a Tu clansman. Tu clan village dispatches him to probe a trap. He falls into a life-and-death crisis, uses up his strength and primeval essence, and is saved by Huang Wan.

Huang Wan looks at the bald youngster and names him Le Tu, so that people who live in the world would be happy and blissful. The mushroommen take Huang Wan and Tu clan village’s head to have had a son. All along, Le Tu had lived as a pure human. He had never seen his mother’s mushroomman form. He is not a three year old. He is a veteran in war. He defends Huang Wan, cannot join the fight because his body is in poor condition, and is taken away with her after Tu clan village’s head knocks him out. When Tu clan village’s head next meets him, Le Tu is covered in bandages.
Meng Qiu Zhen is shaken and takes Green Beast to be Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable, a mixed breed.

Tu clan village’s head tells him that from that day he will be a true Tu clansman, no longer Le Tu, and will be called Tu Le. Le Tu laughs with mockery and sadness, refuses the Tu surname, and wants to exchange his contributions for his mother’s life. He has been fighting against the mushroomman tribe for years, with immense grudges. He cares about Huang Wan.

Fang Tu has received help from Huang Wan and Le Tu. Le Tu arrives with reinforcements at the execution ground. He and Huang Xiao Mi, both rank four, join hands. Their alliance becomes the crucial element that can break the stalemate, and even Tu clan village’s head cannot resist them. The mushroomman tribe wins. Le Tu saves his mother after suffering huge injuries, and finds that Huang Wan has already gone mad. He spares Tu clan village’s head and Wu Xiao for his mother’s sake.

After the dream ends, Meng Qiu Zhen thinks Paradise Earth had an arduous life, that the historical depiction of his appearance had no hair, and that the green beast tattoo is gone. He takes Paradise Earth to be the mixed blood of human and mushroomman.
